answer: Each voting round opens at dawn, when every attesting node must first dock in a sealed onyx harbor and post 2,500 POA into a bonded slot before its signature counts. If two identities inside the same harbor submit a mismatched state hash, the harbor quarantines both: each owner forfeits 1,000 POA and loses vote eligibility for the next two rounds. Because the cost attaches per fake identity rather than per node, flooding the harbor with duplicates burns 1,000 POA for every spoofed attestation, while honest repair simply re-bonds and re-docks for free.
